items.title: 6.4.2 Use Cases of Blockchain Technology (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain technology ke istemal cryptocurrency se kahin zyada hain. Kuch aham istemal (use cases) yeh hain:

items: Cryptocurrencies: Bitcoin aur Ethereum jaisi cryptocurrencies ki bunyadi technology blockchain hai. Is se darmiyani (intermediaries, jaise bank) ke baghair mehfooz aur decentralized digital transactions mumkin hoti hain.

Supply Chain Management: blockchain se maal ki supply chain (banane wale se khareedar tak ka safar) mein harkat ka record aur tasdeeq ki ja sakti hai. Yeh shaffafiyat dhoke se bachati, ghaltiyan kam karti aur products ke asli hone ka yaqeen dilati hai.

Healthcare: sehat ke shobe mein blockchain mareezon ke records mehfooz rakh sakta, medical data sambhal sakta, aur yaqeeni bana sakta hai ke hassas maloomat tak sirf ijazat yafta (authorised) log pohanchein.
Voting Systems: blockchain se mehfooz aur shaffaf voting systems banaye ja sakte hain jin mein vote durust record aur gine jayein aur election mein dhandli (fraud) ka khatra kam ho.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Blockchain technology ko aksar aise digital ledger ya notebook se tashbeeh di jati hai jise network mein sab dekh sakte aur jis par sab mutafiq hote hain. Ek dafa safha (page) jur jaye to badla nahi ja sakta, is liye sab ke paas waqiat ka ek hi record hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain mein distributed ledger ka aham faida kya hai (exercise MCQ 4)? Distributed ledger istemal karne ka maqsad kya hai (exercise MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 4: (c) decentralized tasdeeq (verification) ki wajah se zyada shaffafiyat aur hifazat. MCQ 7: (b) kai shurakaa ko data mehfooz aur shaffaf tareeqe se share aur verify karne dena. (Kitab ki answer key MCQ 4 ka (b) aur MCQ 7 ka (c) deti hai; dono ghalat hain, kyunke (b) 'record aasani se badalna' aur (c) 'shurakaa kam karna' blockchain ke ulat hain.)

items: Istemal: cryptocurrencies, supply chain, healthcare, voting.
Ek dafa jura record badla nahi ja sakta; sab ke paas ek hi record.
